Liam (partnerships): quick one 1: AWS Marketplace sent their Q3 listing pricing + spot/reserved splits. Need a simple blended cost per 1k tokens for the marketplace SKU pricing doc.
Priya (finance): paste the sheet here pls. will run scenarios.
AWS Marketplace: key points: marketplace commission 15% list price; promotional credit for new listings: 3 months at 0% fee if accepted by 2026-06-10; regional spot pools: eu-west limited in Aug.
NVIDIA Partner: FYI our channel partner nodes (A100 equiv) available as reserved at $1.35/gpu_hr; spot at $0.55/gpu_hr with preempt ~18% in peak windows.
Liam (partnerships): thanks. Sam, tokens/GPU-hr assumptions?
Sam (infra): use median 1.0M tokens/GPU-hr for batch gen, 0.9M for conversational. for safety model both.
Priya (finance): ok pasted two scenario tables (conservative reserved-heavy vs spot-heavy). outputs are USD per 1k tokens after marketplace fee.
Priya (finance): Scenario A (70% reserved / 30% spot, batch 1.0M t/gpu-hr): reserved_price 1.35, spot_price 0.55, blended_gpu_hr = 0.7*1.35 + 0.3*0.55 = 1.08, tokens_per_gpu_hr=1_000_000 -> cost_per_1k_tokens_before_fee = 1.08 / (1_000_000/1000) = $0.00108. after 15% marketplace fee -> $0.00127 per 1k tokens.
Priya (finance): Scenario B (50/50 spot, conv 0.9M t/gpu-hr): blended = 0.5*1.35 + 0.5*0.55 = 0.95, cost_per_1k_before_fee = 0.95 / (900_000/1000) = $0.001056, after fee = $0.00124 per 1k tokens.
Liam (partnerships): neat 1. those are in the ballpark of our hosted API unit costs. Note: if we take AWS promo (3mo), effective fee drops and short-term unit cost drops ~15% of list.
AWS Marketplace: confirm: promo reduces platform fee to 0% for 3 months, then returns to 15%. Conditional on acceptance date.
Sam (infra): also callout preempt impact: with 18% preempt you should add ~8-12% buffer to effective cost because of wasted work and failover margins.
Priya (finance): included a preempt adjustment scenario: add 10% uplift to blended GPU cost -> Scenario B w/ preempt uplift becomes $0.00136 per 1k tokens.
ops-bot: action created PM-1987 "Finalize marketplace SKU unit costs" assigned to Priya, due 2026-05-08.
Liam (partnerships): great. I'll add these two bands + promo note into the marketplace pricing brief. Re-open if vendors change numbers. :thumbsup:
